about:
Lennon Telephone Company, operating alongside TVC, Inc., provides telecommunications services from its base in Lennon, Michigan. The company has served the local community for more than 80 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly documented. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed in available sources.

The company delivers a suite of communication services including local telephone, cable television, and internet access. Technical support is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, with support staff located in Ohio. Customers can manage accounts through online bill pay and email services. The company does not manufacture physical products; its operations center on service provision and network maintenance.

Primary customers are residential and business subscribers in the Lennon, Michigan area. The company positions itself as a local provider emphasizing dependability, customer service, and affordability. No specific industry verticals or named enterprise clients are referenced in public materials.

Lennon Telephone Company highlights its long-standing local presence and round-the-clock technical support as key differentiators. The company states its focus is on dependability, customer service, and affordability, aiming to be the leading source for local telecommunication services in its service area.
